trigger: when Z2M logs show repeated failed interviews for a device with modelId=None
before force-removing a battery-powered Tuya sensor from Zigbee2MQTT
when an unknown a4c138 IEEE appears on the HOUSE coordinator 192.168.15.24

before running ha core update on the HA VM
